question: Consider the test class `MultipartStateTest` in `werkzeug_qa/formparser_parse_m3_state/files/testcase.py` (run all of its test methods with pytest, e.g. pytest id `werkzeug_qa/formparser_parse_m3_state/files/testcase.py::MultipartStateTest`). The test never calls the target directly; it builds multipart/form-data request bodies and parses them through werkzeug's form-data parsing entry point. The target function is `werkzeug.formparser.MultiPartParser.parse` in `src/werkzeug/formparser.py`. Aggregate over ALL invocations of this function during the run of ALL test methods in the class (an invocation is one call of the function; invocations that end by raising an exception count too). Collect every value that the local variable `field_size` is ever bound to inside the function's own frame: this includes its initial annotated assignment, the resets when a new part starts, and every update by the augmented assignment `field_size += ...` (the value after the update counts, including an update that is immediately followed by a raise). Values from different invocations are pooled together. Report each distinct value as its Python `repr()` string (an int such as 7 is written as "7"; Python's None is written as "None", not JSON null). Remove duplicates and sort the strings ascending by plain lexicographic Python string comparison (code-point order, so e.g. "105" sorts before "23", and "None" sorts after all digit strings). Answer as JSON of the form {"unique_values": ["...", ...]}.
